inspection.method: All 214 captures were viewed as nine Chrome-rendered contact sheets built from docs/visual-qa/s133-*.png on the site built at 14b50e4d (staging artifact d5762294), plus full-resolution crops of About & Press, the Census page with the scenario board, and the landing page. Separately, every public page was rendered in both themes at 1366 and 390 wide with the new public stylesheet subset and with the full sheet; pixels matched except for screenshots still decoding. The studio owner approved recording this review. The responsive capture used an uncommitted .cache copy of scripts/responsive-evidence.mjs with a 360-second wait for the one-year realism tables.
findings: Census tiles and the scenario board show their counting state in local captures because no community service runs beside the capture server.
The player card download is not among the captured surfaces; tests-ui/player-share-card.spec.js decodes the PNG and checks the silhouette region against a negative control.
About & Press shows the press and contact sections; the footer lists ten links on every public page.
The landing page shows only the ways to start for a new browser; save and backup panels appear for returning browsers.
fixesApplied: Public pages load the part of styles.css they can use; the game keeps the full sheet.
